title: Conviction Hero — Series-A Opening Strike
description: A founder-grade hero slide built around one immovable truth: your positioning sentence. The product mockup arrives beneath it like evidence, not decoration, while the raise metadata whispers from the corner with deliberate restraint.
philosophy: This template treats the first slide as a thesis statement, not a welcome mat. It refuses decorative layering that competes with the single bet a founder is making in the room. The hierarchy is non-negotiable — one claim, one proof, one number, in that order and at that scale. It is designed for the ten seconds before questions begin, not for the slides that follow.
goodFor: Series-A and pre-Series-A live pitch room openers
SaaS or consumer-app founders who can reduce their value prop to one sentence
Cold-send decks where the cover slide is the only guaranteed impression
Presentations projected in large rooms where type must read from 20 feet
avoidFor: Multi-product platforms with no single defensible positioning claim
Chart-heavy quarterly business reviews requiring dense upfront context
Academic or grant proposals that mandate literature review on slide one
Templates reused across multiple slides in the same deck
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The slide should feel like a thesis delivered in a silent room — spare, inevitable, and scaled for twenty feet of distance. All compositional gravity concentrates at the top: one claim so dominant it forecloses argument before questions begin. The mockup arrives below it carrying the quiet authority of proof rather than the warmth of decoration. Avoid anything ornamental — no gradient overlays, no badge clusters, no secondary callouts that dilute the single bet on the canvas. The overall mood is founder-grade certainty: unhurried, undecorated, and completely sure of itself.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid with a generous outer margin (~8%). The positioning headline commands the upper vertical third of the canvas, spanning cols 1–10 for a deliberate left-weighted pull. The product mockup sits center-anchored beneath the headline, scaled to read as corroborating evidence — present and precise, but never as tall as the claim above it. Raise metadata (round label + figure) is pinned bottom-right in a tight two-line lockup; no header band, no rule lines, no folio.

examples.promptCore: The slide reads like a courtroom exhibit — one irrefutable signal commands the left with gravitational authority while the right offers terse, tightly spaced corroboration. The mood is deliberate austerity: no background illustration, no icon grid, nothing that dilutes the singular claim. Asymmetric mass between the two zones creates compositional tension without noise or decoration. Avoid anything that feels template-generated rather than hand-selected evidence in service of a founder's conviction.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid; content occupies cols 2–10 with an 8% outer margin on each side — never edge-to-edge bleed. A dominant left zone (cols 2–6) anchors a single metric, traction claim, or bold assertion at outsized scale, divided from the right zone (cols 7–10) by a razor-thin vertical rule. The right zone holds 2–3 lines of lean corroborating context at a noticeably smaller scale, establishing a strict two-tier hierarchy enforced by size contrast alone, no decorative framing. Slide number sits bottom-right outside the grid; there is no persistent header band.
